summary: Iteration 4 tests the 3 new roadmap features: Export to Markdown, Export to PDF (print popup), Gantt/Timeline toggle, and Roadmap-to-Actions. Extended /app/backend/tests/test_autodelegate.py with TestRoadmapToActions (400 when no roadmap, 404 missing meeting, happy path with dedup verifying second push returns roadmap_actions_added=0) and TestInferActionType (pure-unit import test asserting calendar/gmail/slack/jira inference from task text and tool-name hints). Full pytest: 27/27 PASSED. Frontend UI: on 'Campus Food App Kickoff' from History, roadmap-section renders with export-md-button, export-pdf-button, roadmap-to-approvals-button, view-timeline-button, view-gantt-button. Toggling view-gantt-button renders gantt-view with 3 gantt-row-i bars, timeline toggle brings back 3 phase cards. export-md-button triggered a real download 'Campus_Food_Delivery_App.md' (captured via page.expect_download). export-pdf-button opened a popup (about:blank, then filled with print HTML) with no JS errors. roadmap-to-approvals-button showed toast 'Added 4 roadmap task(s) to approvals.' and navigated to approval view with 7 approval-card-i (3 analysis + 4 roadmap) all clickable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py roadmap_to_actions dedupes by task text lowercased, but a user who edits an action's task then re-pushes will get a duplicate. Consider tracking 'source=roadmap' + originating phase/task id.

RoadmapSection.exportPDF opens window.open('','_blank') without checking null; popup blockers will silently no-op. Consider showing a user-facing toast if w is null and providing a fallback (in-page print or blob URL).

Re-analyze currently sets meeting.roadmap=null (good) but re-pushing roadmap actions after re-analyze will still leave older roadmap-source actions attached because analyze overwrites the actions array with fresh ones — resulting in the roadmap-actions being wiped on re-analyze (data-loss vector for users). Consider preserving source=='roadmap' actions across re-analyze or documenting the behavior.
infer_action_type does simple substring matching; 'meet' matches 'meetings' but also 'commitment'. Only minor; acceptable heuristic.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 new features verified: md-export, pdf-popup, gantt/timeline toggle, roadmap->approvals)

seed_data_creation: Reused existing 'Campus Food App Kickoff' + TEST_campus_food_project (roadmapped) meetings; pytest fixtures created TEST_login_bug, TEST_slack_routing, TEST_campus_food_project.
